unavailable: Python cannot run now: no open browser page is attached to this chat.

variables.packages: the packages the instance provides beyond the standard library, as a list, or "none" — implementation-defined; LLeMbas 2.0: none (the standard library only)
variables.seconds: the time limit of one call, in seconds — implementation-defined; LLeMbas 2.0: 30
variables.memory: the memory limit of one call, with its unit — implementation-defined; LLeMbas 2.0: 512 MB
variables.output: how much printed output comes back, with its unit — implementation-defined; LLeMbas 2.0: 20,000 characters

description:
Run Python for calculations and for working with files — parse JSON or CSV, transform text, compute. It runs in the user's browser (Pyodide), sandboxed: no network, no shell, no packages beyond the standard library and these: {{packages}}. Returns what the code printed and the value of its last expression.

- `files` are copied in before the run, at the same paths, from what this session can read.
- Files the code writes come back only when listed in `save`: each is written as the write tool would write it, with this session's permissions.
- At most {{seconds}} seconds and {{memory}} of memory per call; printed output past {{output}} is cut.
- Every call starts fresh: nothing is kept between calls.

files.description: Files to copy in before the run

save.description: Files the code writes that are to be saved back
